primary_object_card.object_statement: A finite response matrix R: S x P -> O, with explicitly enumerated states, probes, outcomes, response quotients, refinement partitions, typed sequential extensions, transpose dualization, and exact finite probe-subset search; it installs no Chu-category objects, morphisms, tensor, adjunction, or categorical laws.
primary_object_card.plain_language_definition: This kernel records exactly what each finite state returns under each declared finite probe. It derives state equivalence only from matching response vectors, records how adding probes can split but never merge those classes, and permits a typed outcome-adaptive query transcript without pretending that the source table contains a state update law or a category.

source_anchors.quote_or_summary: generate_observations creates the ordered finite G1 surface and is imported read-only to regenerate the real carrier.
G1 declares three direct probe symbols, four outcome labels, history length three, and dependency depth two.
The card fixes the literal matrix carrier and excludes Chu-category laws and online update semantics.

native_terms.response matrix: A total finite table assigning one declared outcome to every declared state and probe pair.
native_terms.row quotient: The partition of states whose selected-probe response vectors are exactly equal under the current finite table.
native_terms.probe power: The equality partition of states induced by one probe, distinct from literal equality of its response column.
native_terms.sequential extension: A deterministic second probe selected from the first outcome, recorded as an ordered finite transcript without a hidden transition law.
native_terms.source row: One regenerated ratchet observation record containing a history, recorded current probe, and recorded source outcome.

weirdness_signature: state identity is relative to the declared probe family
the real carrier preserves duplicate source records even when static requery merges them
sequential transcripts add ordered query syntax without importing source state transitions
primary_object_card.domain: finite synthetic response tables and the regenerated 81-record G1 ratchet observation surface
primary_object_card.codomain_or_output: finite quotient partitions, probe-subset certificates, sequential transcript partitions, transpose checks, and deterministic JSON Lines receipts
allowed_operations: compute row quotients from selected response columns
compute strict and power-based column quotients
exhaustively check monotone refinement over finite probe subsets
extend a probe by an outcome-indexed second probe
transpose the table and verify involution
enumerate minimal separating finite probe subsets
required_invariants: all response cells are total and use declared outcome labels
a larger probe subset only refines a selected row quotient
the source-row recorded outcome agrees with its regenerated matrix cell
two sequentially extended rows cannot split a pair already equal under every static probe
double transpose returns the literal original table
all emitted payload bytes are deterministic before append metadata
forbidden_substitutions: a proxy or learned label replacing the literal response table
four outcome labels treated as four native ratchet probe columns
the ratchet minimal survivor frontier treated as a minimal separating probe family
a static-table quotient treated as an online update or history law
Chu-category objects, morphisms, tensor, adjunction, or categorical laws
finite generated observations treated as scientific or physical evidence
negative_controls: source one-step versus two-step memory-error boundary
commuting-order source control cited as upstream-only evidence
four-outcome one-hot membership view kept separate from direct probes
primary_object_card.adapter_policy: The ratchet generator is a read-only adapter that supplies finite records. The derived 81-by-3 matrix, the outcome-membership view, and rustworkx component check are typed probes or supportive checks; none replaces the literal table.
promotion_locks: no claim that G1 memory depth is universally necessary
no physical, entropy, geometry, manifold, Axis0, or ontology promotion

root_constraints: no hidden categorical or transition structure

lateral_mappings.label: ratchet G1 generator
lateral_mappings.kill_control: If the regenerated source cell disagrees with the recorded row outcome, the real-table receipt fails.

lateral_mappings.label: outcome-adaptive second probe
lateral_mappings.target: finite ordered transcript over a static response table
preconditions: policy is total on declared outcomes
lateral_mappings.kill_control: Any claim that the static transcript imports a source state update or splits a full-static-equivalent pair fails the lane.

lateral_mappings.label: four-outcome membership rendering
lateral_mappings.target: derived one-hot view of each recorded source outcome
preconditions: no pair-family structure is asserted without source evidence

fixation_breakers: test every probe subset rather than privileging a named probe
separate literal column equality from identical distinguishing power
allow static sufficiency to falsify the anticipated sequential-necessity reading

loop_contract.repair_rule: Repair the first literal-table, source-regeneration, or append-only failure before expanding any interpretation.
loop_contract.stop_condition: Two identical deterministic payloads are appended, a freeze record verifies them, and no promotion beyond the finite-kernel ceiling is claimed.

method_contracts.question_is_not_authorization: A question does not grant authorization to introduce category laws, source mutation, or a new online semantics beyond the requested finite table.
method_contracts.order_check_separate: Order is checked separately from content by explicit sequential transcripts and is never inferred from a static quotient alone.
method_contracts.baseline_preservation: The baseline source records and visible outcome labels are preserved while the derived response table is checked.
method_contracts.falsifier_first: The target is sequential necessity; the falsifier is a static probe subset matching the full quotient; the check enumerates subsets and policies, then marks the claim killed, open, or survived.
method_contracts.feynman_testability: The operation is finite response comparison, the observable is the quotient partition, and the pass/fail condition is exact partition equality or a witnessed split.
method_contracts.synthesis_refusal: Synthesis must refuse any merge of a static response receipt with a Chu-category, online-update, scientific, or ratchet-admission claim.
method_contracts.human_offload: Resolve source shape and finite checks with local tools before asking the human for an unrecoverable semantic choice.
